questions.question: Should a disabled account's old orders stay visible to support?

blocks.paragraph: The order-history build is paused on this. Support asked; the spec doesn't say.

options.label: Keep them visible
options.consequence: Support can still look up an old order for a refund.

options.label: Hide them
options.consequence: A disabled account shows nothing, and a refund needs an engineer.

pictures.alt: The order list of a disabled account
pictures.caption: Today it is empty
